caveat: Staff positions come from the same scaffold as the movement data. A camera sees people, not job titles -- separating staff from shoppers on real footage needs uniforms, a badge or a roster joined on shift times, and the accuracy of that step caps everything on this screen. No individual employee is identified.
insight: Most sections are reached quickly. Trials is the exception, and a large share of its shoppers were never reached at all -- those are the ones who walk out unserved.

actions.observed: In most sections a shopper waits about 29 sec before a member of staff is nearby. In Trials, 2% of shoppers were never reached at all.
actions.todo: Nobody browses a rail for ten minutes waiting to be asked. Cover Trials and you convert shoppers who are currently walking out unserved.
